title_sq: VILE PER SHITJE TE REZIDENCA LULEBORE!
description_sq:
VILE PER SHITJE TE REZIDENCA LULEBORE!
Rezidenca Lulebore eshte konceptuar ne nje projekt modern vilash, te organizuara ne tre kate.
Kati nentokesor merr me drite dhe ajrosje naturale dhe eshte i banueshem.
Kati nentokë perbehet nga dy garazhe, ambient teknik, depo, banjo, lavanteri, ambient ndenje/palestre,113.7m2
Kati perdhe perbehet nga korridori, nje banjo, ambient ndenje, kuzhine + ambient ngrenie,110.5m2.
Kati i pare perbehet nga 2 dhoma gjumi, ballkon, banjo ne korridor, dhome matrimoniale + garderobe + banjo brenda ne dhome.110.5m2.
Vila ka hapesire oborri te bollshme dhe me nje hapesire 335.1m2.
Vendndodhje strategjike mes gjelberimit te kodrinave te Lundres, prane TEG, akses direkt ne unazen e madhe, vetem 7,5 km nga gendra e Tiranes, dhe larg zhurmes se Tiranes.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni.
title_en: VILLA FOR SALE IN LULEBORE RESIDENCE!
description_en: VILLA FOR SALE IN LULEBORE RESIDENCE! The Lulebore residence was conceived in a modern project of villas, organized on three floors. The underground floor receives light and natural ventilation and is habitable. The basement consists of two garages, technical area, storage room, bathroom, laundry room, living room/gym, 113.7m2. The ground floor consists of a corridor, a bathroom, living room, kitchen + dining room, 110.5m2. The first floor consists of 2 bedrooms, balcony, bathroom in the corridor, double bedroom + wardrobe + bathroom inside the room. 110.5m2. The villa has ample yard space and an area of ​​335.1m2. Strategic location among the greenery of the hills of Lundre, near TEG, direct access to the big ring road, only 7.5 km from the Tirana road, and away from the noise of Tirana. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us.
